ITEM 1 | Small round green-yellow pieces with pale green outer leaves, some blistered and browned with dark charred spots on the surfaces, dry-looking matte finish with no visible sauce or oil, about 2.5-3 cm across each, cluster of roughly 12 whole pieces piled loosely in the center-left of a white square plate, some overlapping, one darker charred piece on the right side | 110

ITEM 2 | Dark brown to black charred piece with blistered crisp surface and a few green patches, about 3 cm across, sitting alone on the right side of the white plate, dry and matte with no sauce | 20

ITEM 3 | Plate surface: bare white ceramic, no food residue or sauce visible apart from the pieces above | 0
